objective: Define one authority-neutral robot-bowl contact vocabulary, reproduce the current scripted-expert and ACT G3 decisions from frozen source, and freeze a future shared-classifier integration design without selecting or changing the active safety policy.

authoritative_inputs.role: predecessor review contract and evidence boundaries
zero-safety-failure promotion requirement without a robot-bowl allowlist
collision-class vocabulary only; geometry remains frozen
stage and sampling vocabulary only; timing remains frozen
accepted G3 evidence and asset boundary

validation_rules: clamp_relation must be active, inactive, or unknown when robot_geometry is clamp
clamp_relation must be not_applicable when robot_geometry is nonclamp
stage other represents every non-place, non-release, non-retreat suffix
collider_class is descriptive and must not alter either frozen current classifier
normalized_contact_context.multi_pair_aggregation: A bowl contact set is allowed only when every normalized pair is allowed by the selected policy. Any forbidden pair forbids the set; any unresolved pair makes the set unresolved unless a forbidden pair is already present.

scripted_expert_v131.selected_bowl: allow because sample_safety skips the selected bowl entirely
scripted_expert_v131.nonselected_bowl: allow only when stage is place or release, robot geometry is an active-side clamp, and every pair for that bowl satisfies the same condition; otherwise forbid

act_g3_current.all_bowls: allow when every robot geometry in a pair is a clamp; otherwise forbid

algorithm: evaluate the normalized context under the frozen scripted-expert projection
evaluate the same context under the frozen ACT G3 projection
return the common decision when both decisions match
return unresolved when the decisions differ
authority_neutral_shared_decision.safety_property: No unresolved context is silently converted to allow or forbid.
authority_neutral_shared_decision.non_authority_statement: This consensus projection exposes agreement and divergence; it is not an executable competition safety policy and is not authorized for runtime integration.

shared_components: one explicit policy identifier selected by future authority
one classifier implementation called by both scripted and ACT adapters
one cross-adapter parity matrix over every normalized dimension
adapter_responsibilities: map simulator contact labels to robot_geometry and collider_class
supply stage, selected bowl, and active side without changing their meanings
fail closed on malformed or unmappable context
emit policy identifier and normalized decision in evidence
forbidden_designs: treating unknown side or selection state as allowed
collider-name-specific relaxation without a separately authorized geometry and safety review
automatic selection of scripted or ACT semantics from this work package
promotion_prerequisites: user authorization for runtime safety-rule implementation
an authoritative choice for every unresolved matrix cell
static parity tests for both adapters
separately authorized dynamic validation before any G3, collection, export, or training claim

candidate_policy_risk_order.risk: lowest for this phase because it preserves evidence and prevents accidental policy promotion
would reject the observed seed-1630 retreat pair and may preserve a stage-boundary false positive
would broadly allow clamp contact across stage, side, and selectedness without task-authority evidence
would be a new safety rule requiring separate authority and dynamic evidence

downstream_blocked: controller, threshold, timing, safety-rule, or geometry changes
collection, export, training, inference, or publication

acceptance_matrix.expected: Every authoritative and predecessor hash matches.
The new module uses only the Python standard library and is not imported by either runtime executor.
Representative and exhaustive normalized cases match exact source semantics, including multi-pair all aggregation.
The WP-015 retreat pair classifies scripted=forbid, ACT=allow, shared=unresolved.
No code, config, or document selects a divergent allow or forbid decision as authoritative.
Frozen executor, controller, safety, threshold, geometry, timing, asset, data, and training sources remain hash-identical; no simulator or remote access occurs.
Focused tests pass; all functional regressions pass; only the two immutable predecessor source-pin sentinels fail as expected.
A fresh no-overwrite terminal receipt and SHA-256 manifest verify.

claim_boundary: This local work package may define and validate an authority-neutral vocabulary, faithfully model the two frozen current classifiers, expose agreement and divergence, and freeze a future shared-integration design. It cannot choose the correct competition safety policy, modify runtime behavior, establish repair validity, explain the unobserved release contact manifold, prove dynamic adapter parity, establish G3 passage, authorize collection or training, establish AMD/ROCm behavior, validate hardware safety, or authorize publication.
